category: Define Security Requirements for Software Development (PO)
subcategory_text: Identify and document all security requirements for the organization's software development processes and the software that the organization develops. These requirements include compliance with applicable laws and regulations, organizational security policies, and the organization's security plan.
implementation_examples: Define the security requirements for each software development project at the planning stage before any code is written
Document the security requirements in a Software Requirements Specification (SRS) or equivalent artefact
Trace each security requirement to one or more applicable laws, regulations, standards, and policy clauses
assessment_objectives: Determine whether security requirements for software development are identified and documented.
Determine whether security requirements include applicable laws, regulations, and policies.
Determine whether security requirements are reviewed and approved before software development begins.
